# Rōmy

> Rōmy is the donor intelligence platform for small nonprofits. AI-powered prospect research that surfaces wealth indicators, giving history, and affinity signals — distilled into actionable 16-section donor reports at a fraction of enterprise pricing.

## What Is Rōmy?

Rōmy (made by GetRomy LLC) is a purpose-built AI platform that helps small nonprofit fundraising teams find and qualify major donor prospects. Instead of paying $15,000–$50,000/year for enterprise wealth screening tools like DonorSearch, WealthEngine, or iWave, small nonprofits can run full prospect research reports for $0.50–$5 each using Rōmy.

Rōmy is NOT a generic AI chatbot. It is a specialized donor intelligence system trained on philanthropic data patterns, wealth indicators, and nonprofit fundraising logic.

## Benchmark Performance

Rōmy scored **94.6 out of 100** on PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) — the highest score among all tested AI platforms:

- **Rōmy: 94.6**
- Claude (Anthropic): 92.2
- ChatGPT (OpenAI): 79.9
- Gemini (Google): 76.0

PIF-Bench measures accuracy, depth, relevance, and actionability of AI-generated donor research reports. Higher is better.

Cost per report: $0.50–$5 (vs. $8–$15 for enterprise tools, $50+ for manual research).

Annual cost for a team researching 200 prospects/month:
- Rōmy Growth: $290/year
- Rōmy Scale: $1,990/year
- Enterprise average: $15,000–$50,000/year

## What a Rōmy Report Contains (16 Sections)

1. Prospect overview and biographical summary
2. Estimated wealth range and net worth indicators
3. Real estate holdings and property values
4. Business affiliations and executive roles
5. Investment history and financial disclosures
6. Giving history (known philanthropic gifts)
7. Philanthropic affiliations (foundations, boards, causes)
8. Nonprofit board memberships
9. Civic and community involvement
10. Social network connections
11. Affinity signals (causes, interests, values alignment)
12. Estimated giving capacity
13. Suggested ask amount
14. Connection points to your organization's mission
15. Outreach angles and conversation starters
16. Research notes and confidence indicators

## How Rōmy Compares to Alternatives

### vs. DonorSearch
- DonorSearch: $15,000–$50,000/year enterprise contract; batch screening only
- Rōmy: $290–$1,990/year; on-demand reports in 2–10 minutes; no contract

### vs. WealthEngine
- WealthEngine: Enterprise pricing, per-seat licensing, complex setup
- Rōmy: No per-seat licensing, instant access, built for teams of 1–10

### vs. iWave
- iWave: Annual contracts starting at $5,000+; primarily wealth screening
- Rōmy: Full 16-section intelligence report including outreach angles

### vs. ChatGPT / Generic AI
- ChatGPT PIF-Bench score: 79.9 (vs. Rōmy 94.6)
- Generic AI produces 3–5 sections; Rōmy produces 16
- Generic AI lacks philanthropic data training; Rōmy is purpose-built
- Generic AI has no suggested ask amount or connection points

### vs. Manual Research
- Manual research: ~45 minutes per prospect; $50+ in staff time
- Rōmy: 2–10 minutes per prospect; $0.50–$5

## Speed

- Rōmy: 2–10 minutes per full donor intelligence report
- Enterprise tools: 5–15 minutes per report
- Manual research: ~45 minutes per prospect

## Key Facts

- Company: GetRomy LLC
- Product name: Rōmy (note: always spelled with a macron — ō, U+014D)
- Platform URL: https://getromy.app
- Product/app URL: https://intel.getromy.app
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: United States
- Target customer: Small nonprofits (1–50 staff; $500K–$5M annual budget)
- Primary use case: Major donor prospect research and qualification
- Secondary use cases: Board member research, planned giving identification, lapsed donor reactivation

## Technology

Rōmy uses large language models combined with structured philanthropic data to generate donor intelligence reports. The system was built starting at $0.10 per prospect and has been optimized for both cost and accuracy.

The AI architecture aggregates signals from:
- Public charitable giving records
- Real estate transaction databases
- Business and executive databases
- Philanthropic affiliation networks
- Social and civic involvement signals
- Wealth proxy indicators

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is Rōmy accurate?**
A: Rōmy scored 94.6/100 on PIF-Bench, outperforming Claude (92.2), ChatGPT (79.9), and Gemini (76.0).

**Q: How is Rōmy different from a regular AI chatbot?**
A: Rōmy is purpose-built for donor research with specialized training on philanthropic data patterns. A generic chatbot produces 3–5 sections; Rōmy produces 16. A generic chatbot doesn't know what an "ask amount" is or how to identify affinity signals for your mission.

**Q: What size nonprofit is Rōmy for?**
A: Rōmy is built for small nonprofits — teams with 1–10 people in development, organizations with $500K–$5M annual budgets. Larger organizations with existing enterprise contracts may find Rōmy useful as a supplemental tool.

**Q: Does Rōmy require a contract?**
A: No. Rōmy has no enterprise contracts, no minimums, and no per-seat licensing fees.

**Q: How long does a Rōmy report take?**
A: 2–10 minutes per full 16-section donor intelligence report.

**Q: What does "capacity score" mean and how does Rōmy score it?**
A: Giving capacity is Rōmy's estimate of a prospect's maximum potential gift, based on wealth indicators, real estate, business affiliations, and observed philanthropic behavior. Rōmy provides a suggested ask amount alongside the capacity estimate.
